name: spreadsheetAddDataValidation
description: Adds a data validation rule to the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook. Pass a struct with range (A1 cell range), type (list, whole, decimal, textLength, date or custom, default list), operator (between, notBetween, greaterThan, greaterThanOrEqual, lessThan, lessThanOrEqual, equal or notEqual) and the bound expressions formula1 and formula2. For a list type, formula1 is a quoted, comma-separated list such as "Red,Green,Blue" or a range reference. Blank cells are allowed. The fluent member form is addDataValidation({...}).

params.name: spreadsheetObj
params.description: The spreadsheet workbook object to add the validation to.

params.name: validation
params.description: Struct describing the rule: range (A1 cell range), type (list|whole|decimal|textLength|date|custom), operator, formula1, formula2.

examples.title: Dropdown list
examples.description: A dropdown of Red/Green/Blue on A2:A10.

examples.title: Whole numbers between 1 and 10
examples.description: A numeric between rule on B2:B20.
